title: Frame preservation under tape embedding
statement: Let $x$ be an input word, let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $m$ work tapes, and let $\iota : \{0,\ldots,m-1\} \hookrightarrow \{0,\ldots,k-1\}$ be an embedding of tape indices. Choose initial contents $T_j : \mathbb{Z} \to \mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Symbol})$ and head positions $h_j \in \mathbb{Z}$ for each of the $k$ tapes, an output prefix $p$, an $m$-tape configuration $c$ on input $x$, and $t \in \mathbb{N}$. After $t$ steps of the $k$-tape machine obtained from $M$, starting with $M$'s tapes embedded by $\iota$, the other tapes still have contents $T_j$ and head positions $h_j$; the input-head position agrees with the position after $t$ steps of $M$ from $c$, and the output is $p$ followed by the output after those $t$ steps of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices
Initial contents for each of the $k$ work tapes
Initial head positions for each of the $k$ work tapes
